nt2e61.title: In This House: Cancer's rules
nt2e61.caption: Cancer will send you home with five tubs of soup and then text "home safe" from the mailbox. Twelve steps. Which rule does your house have?

nt2e62.title: In This House: an Aries and Virgo home
nt2e62.caption: Aries wins every race to the door, then holds it open anyway. Virgo labels the chaos. And every fight starts with snacks. Who in your house runs the label maker?

nt2e63.title: In This House: Aquarius rules
nt2e63.caption: The robot arm hands you the remote, Thursday is rock collection night, and "I love you" no longer comes in binary. What's the weirdest rule you'd keep?

nt2e64.title: In This House: Capricorn's calendar
nt2e64.caption: Every square of the week is planned except one, circled twice: NOTHING. Capricorn in striped socks, resting on purpose. Tag the friend who needs that square.

nt2e65.title: In This House: Libra says no
nt2e65.caption: Teal or plum? They talked it out. The chipped mug is the favourite. And a fourth weekend plan got a kind, clear "not this time." Proud of you, Libra.

nt2e66.title: Plot Twist: the late date
nt2e66.caption: Twenty minutes late, three drafts deleted, one map with three pins. Meanwhile they were outside the door practising hello. Which sign rehearses their entrance?

nt2e67.title: Plot Twist: the hummed tune
nt2e67.caption: You hum one tune on date one, they go quiet, then it's "busy!" for three days. Turns out they were learning to play it. One note wrong, every bit of heart.

nt2e68.title: Plot Twist: Friday got cancelled
nt2e68.caption: "can't do friday, sorry" and Cancer's spiral reaches the soup by Tuesday. Then the next text: Saturday, blanket fort, no alarms. Be honest, how fast do you spiral?

nt2e69.title: Plot Twist: still typing
nt2e69.caption: The dots go on, off, on, and Aries has pictured a twelve-part essay. The message: can I call you instead? Some people just want to hear your voice.

nt2e70.title: Plot Twist: "we need to talk"
nt2e70.caption: Libra rehearsed every bad ending in the mirror and walked to the bench like a movie. It was a talk card: what made you smile this week? Answer in the comments.

nt2e71.title: If the Fire Signs Were Weather
nt2e71.caption: Aries is the sunny day in winter that makes everyone ditch their scarves. Leo is golden hour that never ends. Sag is the tailwind that takes your kite somewhere new.

nt2e72.title: If the Earth Signs Were Weather
nt2e72.caption: Taurus is blanket-and-drizzle weather. Virgo checked twice, it's clear, and brought you an umbrella anyway. Capricorn: frosty hello, warm by noon. Which one are you?

nt2e73.title: If the Air Signs Were Weather
nt2e73.caption: Gemini is partly sunny, partly cloudy and talking the whole time. Libra is the perfect breeze. Aquarius is a cloud shaped like a question mark. Who's your forecast?

nt2e74.title: If the Water Signs Were Weather
nt2e74.caption: Cancer is the rainy night you stay in. Scorpio is fog that lifts and shows you everything. Pisces is a sun shower, crying and glowing at once. Who are you on a rainy night?

nt2e75.title: If the Signs Were Winter Weather
nt2e75.caption: Sagittarius is the first snow, everyone sprinting outside. Capricorn is a clear, freezing night full of stars. Cancer is the frosted window you draw a heart on.

nt2e76.title: Little Treat: Aries listened
nt2e76.caption: Aries let a whole story finish without jumping in, let them pick the place, and said "I like you" first. Three wins, three treats, and one surprise cupcake. What's your treat?

nt2e77.title: Little Treat: Cancer went out
nt2e77.caption: Cancer left the house, made it through the movie with dry eyes (Pisces cried enough for both), and said what it needs out loud. That last one gets a whole cake.

nt2e78.title: Little Treat: Capricorn logged off
nt2e78.caption: Out the door at 6:00 on the dot, phone face down at dinner, and someone else got to make the plan. Capricorn deserves every single pretzel. Who needs to log off tonight?

nt2e79.title: Little Treat: Gemini focused
nt2e79.caption: Five chats down to one. Remembered the dog's name (Biscuit). Asked a talk card question and listened to the whole answer. Gemini, that's a sundae. What's your focus treat?

nt2e80.title: Little Treat: Pisces, shared
nt2e80.caption: Pisces cried at the movie only once, said no to a plan it didn't want, then cried happy tears on date one. So did the date. Two spoons, one pie. Who's your crying buddy?
